locator.section: 8.7 Radical-site initiation (one bond cleaved without rearrangement)

evidence.curator_note: Generic scheme 8.41: OE+. AB-C-D --alpha--> AB. + C=D+ (radical-site initiation, charge retention on D). Book draws 2 arcs; move 1 is drawn (D's odd electron [+. on D, right fishhook] -> forming C=D pi bond) and move 2 is drawn (one electron of the AB-C sigma bond [left arc] -> forming C=D pi bond); move 3 is an implicit homolysis hook (the other AB-C electron -> departing AB radical), required for electron balance and NOT drawn on the page (AB. is simply written as a product). Reactivity scale printed under the scheme: N > S, O, pi, R. > Cl, Br > H (radical-site donating ability).

Equation 8.41 is fully generic (letters AB, C, D) and prints NO m/z and NO intensity. Instantiated here on diethyl-ether radical cation (D=O, the heteroatom site) so the arrows have real atoms and the cross-linked MOeD rule IMS_4_13_1 matches atom-for-atom: AB=CH3 (map1, leaves as CH3.), C=CH2 (map2, alpha carbon), D=O (map3, radical/charge site bearing the spectator ethyl maps 4/5). Detected ion m/z 59.0491 (C3H7O+, ethoxymethylene oxocarbenium) and precursor m/z 74.0726 are curator-computed monoisotopic values from this instantiation, NOT numbers read from the page; species are flagged detected=false / peak status inferred accordingly. ms_context reflects the standard EI molecular-ion (M+.) context of the generic alpha-cleavage; this page (Section 8.7) shows no CAD/MI/CI experiment.

Equation 8.41 has NO MOeD rule of its own (rule_index by_equation["8.41"] = null); the text cites Equations 4.13-4.15 as the concrete alpha-cleavage cases. VERIFIED cross-link: IMS_4_13_1 (dfs [C]1..[C]5[O+.]8[C]9..>> [C.]1 . [C]5{=}[O+]8[C]9..) is the charge-RETENTION alpha cleavage of the same saturated ether radical cation this record instantiates: it cleaves the AB-C sigma bond (1-5), forms the C=D pi bond (5=8), the cleaved bond IS incident to the pi-forming alpha carbon (atom 5) -> correct alpha-cleavage geometry, matches scheme 8.41 as drawn. IMS_4_13_2 is the charge-MIGRATION sibling (product [C+]5{-}[O]8, charge moves to carbon, O neutral) corresponding to the Stevenson's-rule alternative discussed in the surrounding text (Eq 8.40); it is NOT the pathway drawn in 8.41. IMS_4_14 (C=O+. >> C#O+) is the analogous alpha cleavage at an UNSATURATED heteroatom (double->triple, acylium), the same reaction type one bond order higher, not the single->double form drawn here.
